leadText: Magical Pokémon Journey: Fun at the Beach is the fourth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino. It contains the first three bonus chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
plainText:
Magical Pokémon Journey: Fun at the Beach is the fourth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino. It contains the first three bonus chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
==Blurb==
THE BRINY DEEP

3 stories this issue! Hazel goes to the beach with Almondo, and with the help of a Horsea, learns the wonders of the underwater Pokémon world. 

Then, frightening ghost Pokémon await Hazel in the Tunnel of Horrors-but for Hazel, cuteness is in the eye of the beholder!

Finally, Jigglypuff causes trouble at a Pokémon birthday party.

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Horsea's Necklace
Wh-Who's Sc-Scared?!
Party Time!

==Important events==
Horsea makes his first appearance.
Hazel and Almond take part in Grandpa's "Test of Courage".
The group celebrates Almond's birthday.
